text: This report recommends that the name "Natale Bozzo Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located west of Royal York Road, extending between Hay Avenue and Simpson Avenue. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/ This naming proposal is in alignment with the objectives of the Guiding Principles for Commemoration in the Public Realm.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Natale Bozzo Lane" for an existing public lane located west of Royal York Road, extending between Hay Avenue and Simpson Avenue.
